findings.title: Editing an ethical draft can reassign it to another owner's pharmacy and another product without destination authorization.
findings.scenario: Tom delegates preparation of his ethical listing to Omar. Omar edits that DRAFT with Nadia's unrelated pharmacy identifier and another approved product. The update saves the reassignment without proving Omar can manage Nadia's pharmacy or that he is approved for the replacement product. Nadia's stock workflow can then contain Tom's unauthorized listing.
findings.test_needed: Create a draft owned by pharmacy A. As authorized A preparer, PATCH its pharmacy to unrelated B and product to unapproved S8; assert 403/400 and no owner/product/lot/audience changes. Valid description-only update remains allowed.

owner_question.question: May Omar move a draft ethical medicine listing from Tom's premises to Nadia's unrelated premises without the destination owner authorising it?
options: No; immutable pharmacy and product with fresh draft required for material changes
Only with explicit authorization from both pharmacy owners and new product policy checks
Yes; leave the existing draft PATCH behavior
